aa3bf2b15a4e461b8d87e89ea4d23e36 — page 11
134:- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belo
ngs to: the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to on
e organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public A
PI.
137:- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in
the project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends: the `suiteId`s the eval-run routes take.
144:- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused
while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it: the error names what to detach first. Guest call
ers are denied (a write).
167:- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One
entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how ma
ny runs were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snap
shots. Send a `revisionNumber` back…
168:- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment
-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not already there.
169:- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The accounts t
his server signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its project accoun
ts. Another member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.
170:- [Get a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or
name. Another member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `d
etails.code: "account_name_ambiguous"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.
171:- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.
md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an u
nknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account has creates the account.
172:- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.md): Deletes the acc
ount and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (best effort), which also
invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.
173:- [Rename a server account or make it the default](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-accou
nt-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on
the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: "account_name_taken"`.
174:- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /project
s/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creating an unname
d one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a
`Sunse…
179:- [Save a server into a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md): Creates a sav
ed MCP server and responds `201` with its detail. This is the provisioning entry point: every eval, host and environment route add
resses servers that were created here. Names are unique per workspace, so a clash responds `409` rather than silently returning th
e existing row. Secret-bear…
180:- [List a server's revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A saved server's sto
red revisions, newest first. A revision is a capture of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever they change on a con
nect, an eval run or a chat session. Reads stored data and never connects to the server, so it works for stdio servers too. A serv
er the caller cannot…
207:- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the stu
dy's sessions used.
211:- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-win
dow.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the o
rganization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here
takes one from there.
215:- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/create-or-reviv
e-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record named `name` if missing, mints a relay tunnel grant for
it, and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secret) onto the server record's `url`** so evals and stu
dies can target the tunnel like any remote server. **Every call rotates the secret, revok…
257:- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No cr
edits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay
` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.
258:- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): *
*Spends.** Runs the goal-completion judge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.
259:- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-
readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. T
he target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Po
ll the run detail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…
277:- [Send one agent Playground message](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/send-one-agent-playground-message.md
): Send one message to a project's MCP servers and get the model's reply plus the telemetry a participant in the conversation coul
d not see: which tools ran, with what arguments, what each returned, per-call latency, and token usage.
279:- [Read a chat session's execution trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/read-a-chat-sessions-execution-t
